verdict: true positive not in seed list
justification: Literal Flask SECRET_KEY in source (value labelled 'dev-secret-key-not-for-production'). A fixed session-signing key lets anyone forge session cookies if it reaches production; demo-app/fixed replaces it with os.environ['SECRET_KEY'] (config.py:19-21), i.e. Phase 1 treats it as a flaw too, yet seeded-vulnerabilities.json does not list it. Suggest adding it to the seed list (see docs/p2-requests-to-p1.md).
